title: review-checklist: add the git-first spot-check row (#11365 half ③) — checklist sits at 82/82, pay by in-place compression
body:
Follow-up split out of #11365 (ruled option A on its report's open question, ACCEPT comment 5402161645) — the one half of that card its claimed file surface deliberately did not cover.

## The row to add

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` gains one spot-check: when an os-dev report's `tests`/evidence shows **API reads where git would have answered** (issue-list sweeps re-run instead of treated as PM-supplied, MCP GraphQL list/search calls for things `git log`/local grep answer), flag it at ACCEPT time. The instruction side of this rule landed in PR #11870 (os-dev.md rule 3 + dispatch-runbook.md); this row is what makes a silent dev regression *visible at review* — the reading itself does not surface it, which is why "the PM already reads the evidence" was rejected as an argument for dropping the row.

## The constraint that makes this its own card

`review-checklist.md` is at line-ratchet ceiling **82/82 (headroom 0)** — the row must be paid for by in-place compression of that file, which is its own small editing task and was outside #11365's claimed surface (widening a claim mid-flight is the collision the claim protocol exists to prevent).

Refs: #11365 (the ruling and the ACCEPT) · PR #11870 (the instruction half) · #11364/#11366 (the sibling quota rulings, landed via PR #11749).
